notes.title: 2022 Roadmap, Updates, Public Beta Testing News, and more.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Firstly, I sincerely apologize for the delays in updates, and the delays in publishing the game.

Today im going to go over some concerns you guys have voiced, as well as give you some more insight / updates into the game.


So recently, over the past few months we have been finalizing multiplayer aspects of the game, adding in functionality like leaderboards, voice chat, custom role names, and server configuration files. This has taken quite a bit longer than expected due to some headaches that have come up, but it has been mostly completed and is working well.

We anticipate release in the next forecoming months, but cannot give a exact date as of now sadly. That date will depend on the q/a and public testing.
With that being said, the next step for us is finishing off the game in terms of polish, animations, models, and testing. We will be undergoing that for a short period of time, then in which we will be opening it up to public testing before release. 

Public testing will be hosted on steam from the new Steam Playtest feature. The way this works is once this announcement is live, you guys can go to the store page and click on the 'Request Access' Button. [Or something along those lines] Near the top of the page. This will enter you into a list where you can be selected to test the game.

The game will be tested in regions to test server durability and strength, client-server bugs, and anything else network related that may show up. By signing up onto the list you can help us make sure the game is running the best it can be before release, AND you can give us input into the design, feel, and overall enjoyment of the game so we can make changes as needed.


Im really excited for getting close to a release, and I want to thank you all for the amazing support we've had and this amazing community. I couldn't have gotten this far without you all. [And also the amazing studio staff behind me]

More news will be released in the next coming bit. Stay posted.

If you want to receive updates and news even more often, and be the first to hear of it, join our discord. Its free and you get to chat with the community and see new stuff!

[url=https://www.arcmeda.com/discord]Click here to join the Official SCP:FF Discord[/url]

Thank you,
-Phonicz

notes.title: Discord Progress Discussion, plus Q/A
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Firstly, My apologies for the massive delays in updates to the game on discord, or even on here.

notes.title: Server News + Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Phonicz here, The lead developer for SCP:FF.


Its been a while since the last update was released for all of you, so I apologize for that. Its been quite the busy time. I'll give a brief rundown over progress.

Due to some issues, the store page cannot get the screenshots added at this moment. They will be added to the discord for now.

As for servers, a lot of you are in the discord server following update news [i](If youre not you really should join!)[/i] but for those of you who havent heres a brief summary. I have been working on steam servers for the past few weeks with a lot of small issues coming up with finding and getting them working.
I am however very pleased to announce dedicated servers are now working properly and seem to have very minor issues if any! 

We also are taking a look at the new feature from steam called Playtest's. Some of you may have seen this in a announcement from steam, but if not ill briefly explain it. Steam Playtests will give us the ability to allow a select group of players (Depending on region and number we want to) to play the game for a limited period of time, then revoke access. This allows us to stress-test certain region-specific aspects of the game, and general server loading as well. Further information about how to join will come in the next little bit on steam as well as in the discord server.

[u]What does this mean for you as a player/server host?[/u]

For players, this means that we will soon be able to be testing the game on open Betas before Early Access. This gives us the ability to stress test our services, authentication, and work on the game to tweak it and balance before release to the general public.
For server hosts, this means that in the near future you will be able to host your own server [i](Preferably on Ubuntu, but windows x64 is supported)[/i] and get players on ahead of public release. More information will be coming in the server hosts channel in the discord.


Thank you all for being patient with us, We are nearing the end now as we test servers and balancing, and may soon be ready for a release.
I'm only a one man developer team, and with a small studio of 17 behind me. But I can speak for all of them and say we are proud with how far the game has come, and amazed to have such a great community like all of you behind us! It truly helps a ton. (Especially the patreons that have helped us afford new content)


-Phonicz

notes.title: March Update + News
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

First off, I want to thank you all for your patience and dedication, Our wishlist count and follower count has gone up hugely over the past few months, and I appreciate every single one of you!

You probably expected the game to be out by now, and trust me we did too. But I looked at a lot of the core mechanics and they were just not as polished as I was wanting, so I took the time to rework them. Please view the list below of the major changes we have done and work over the past bit.

[list]
[*] COMPLETE inventory Overhaul. Entire new design, more scp-style with a dark theme to it.
[*] Pickup system overhaul. New text and pickup code to perform smoother on servers.
[*] COMPLETE overhaul of the procedural generation system. Now rooms spawn more randomly, and the zone sizes have a greater depth to them. (They can spawn small some rounds or large others) Theres now also more paths to escape and the map has started to use Level Streaming to only load in the parts of the map that are needed to better optimize framerate.
[*] Main Menu Overhaul. Complete new system for keybinds, making it easy and simple. New audio settings, options, and more.
[*] New main menu music, 3 tracks, as well as others being used throughout the game.
[*] Network spawning optimization. Players now re-spawn smoother, with minimal server load.
[*] Re-organized some of the main game-mode to better trigger events, such as death logic, win conditions, etc.
[*] Improved the player name tag system with different fonts and new textures.
[*] Lots of backend bug fixes.
[/list]

I have also done extensive testing with different graphics settings, and areas to optimize the game the best possible. Overall there has been minimal drops with particle effects and bullet vfx.


I will also be posting some images to discord of these features mentioned above, with more to come in the future. 


And for patreons, you now have access to the new patreon version, which will get more frequent updates. Check the discord for more info.


Once again, Thank you all for your patience. I think that this time spent on better polishing the game was worth it, and we are now nearing the end. More news will come shortly!

-Phonicz

notes.title: February Mid-Month Update, Animations Preview, and a small Teaser.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I want to thank you all for the support, questions, and suggestions we have gotten over the many months of development! This truly does help us a lot and allows us to better understand what you guys want in a game!

We have done a lot of work as well on Optimization, and tested with a variety of systems ranging from high end gaming pc's, to lower tier laptops. In the video you will be able to see a fps counter, as well as myself showcasing the current settings if youre interested. Nonetheless good progress has been made on it and we're fairly satisfied with where its at now.

[u]I have also released a small [b]video[/b] for you guys, which can be viewed [/u][url=https://youtu.be/A8wOa5nUBcE]here.[/url]

Anyways, onto some news and tidbits. Lets get through the first part in bullet form.

[b][h1]February Update and new features;[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] New weapon animations added for guns, Currently only MP40 and P08 Officially are shown, with more in the works.
[*] Re-worked the weapon system for a smoother and more dynamic playthrough of weapon swapping, item pickups, etc.
[*] Re-worked the inventory system to alleviate some bugs and present a more polished user experience.
[*] Configured and smoothed SCP-457's abilities a bit more, as well as optimized fire particles to have the most fps possible.
[*] Complete overhaul of the main menu, with a more 'horror/darker' look to it.
[*] Improved the leaderboard with more polish, as well as added a steam profile button to view a users steam profile [i](Which can be toggled to be publicly visible or not through a setting)[/i]
[*] Added in-game role markers above the users name in the nametag display.
[*] Improved the pickup widget to give user's more variety on which type of visual indicator they want to use [i](or none at all)[/i] for interacting with items
[*] Re-Worked the procedural generation system to allow for more paths for escape, as well as balanced some rooms for gameplay.


We have also done a lot of behind the scenes networking and backend features, mostly with multiplayer, server list's and more. Those will be shown and discussed in a later update.

We previewed some of these features in the discord, so [i](shameless plug) [/i]feel free to join to see them as they happen! Invite link is pinned in the community hub.


[h2]Addressing further development and release date(s);[/h2]

We know you guys are anxiously awaiting the games release, and we did anticipate releasing sometime around now, but we have held off and decided to put more time into polishing the game to make it a more enjoyable, bug-free experience for you all. That being said, we do not have a full release date yet, but we do expect within the next few months to be able to present a near-public ready build.

Personally I have been dealing with a lot of hassle with school, but still managing as much as I can with development programming wise, and the rest of the studio has done a ton with models and animations, as well as balancing weapons and items and designing new rooms.

Thank you all for your patience, and we will be sure to keep you updated with further news!

-Phonicz / Noah Knorr



[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Update + First look at the game
notes.notes:
Hello SCP:FF Community,

As we near the end of this year, we thought it would be important to let you know about how far we've come, progress on the game, updates happening in the first few months of 2021, and some more little tidbits about development.

Firstly, a lot of you have asked for a video of the current facility. Currently we have surface, entrance, admin, safe, and silo done in their first forms. Euclid and keter are being worked on and expected to be out within the next 2-3 weeks. We recorded a short in-game video of the patreon demo of those zones. Hopefully you enjoy! Let us know your thoughts on it!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-dZIJKt0Wmw&feature=youtu.be]link to the video here[/url]

As for development progress;

We are almost done the map as stated above, and once that is done we will work more extensively on weapons and finishing the scp's we already have half done, and adding new ones. We have begun to draw up concept art for some that are not modeled yet, and will send them out to be done shortly.

On another note relating to the real world, Covid-19 is still growing and we hope that with all of the christmas and new year holidays you all stay safe and have a great start to 2021.


Thank you all for helping be part of this amazing journey, and I'm so glad to have you all with me for it.
Looking forward to a amazing year ahead of us!

-Phonicz
-Arcmeda CEO

notes.title: November DevBlog
notes.notes:
[b]Hello SCP : FF Community![/b]

Phonicz here, the Lead and Solo dev for the game. I'm here to tell you about all the work we've done over the past month, and what we have in store for future updates in the next few months. 
You may have also noticed that there was not a lot of map updates / visual improvements this month. That is because we spent a week and a bit at least improving core gameplay / core functionality of the game. We thought this was necessary time spent to improve the playing experience later. As well as a lot of time was spent optimizing code and the game in general. Nonetheless we have some exciting updates listed below.


[h1]Major Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked the shooting system to give a realistic option and a more arcade style option.
[*] The new overhaul of weapon mechanics also comes with a brand new clean and minimal HUD, meant to give a cinematic view to the game when no weapon is being used.
[*] New parts of the map have been made, and more progress is ongoing on finishing it up.
[*] GUN CUSTOMIZATION! No attachments are made now, but we have a working attachment system to be used later.
[/list]


[h1]Medium Game Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Complete new nametag system, and voice chat system starting to be implemented.
[*] SCP-457's Fire ability has gotten some reworking and balancing. Now is looking close to a final stage.
[*] Numerous bug fixes, too many to count.
[*] Game optimization. Code has been cleaned up and map lighting improved as much as possible.
[/list]

[h3]Future Updates/Plans[/h3]
[list]
[*] Campaign mode has had extensive work done to it, with a lot of the storyline for the first few chapters being worked on.
[*] We are contemplating the idea of making the first campaign level a publicly playable demo in the next coming months, while we fine-tune the multiplayer. Tell us your thoughts on that in the discord or on the steam forums!
[*] New SCP-Concepts. After hearing feedback from users, we have looked extensively at adding a few more interesting SCP's into the game.
[*] AI. Minor work has already started on it, and more will be coming in the future for singleplayer and potentially multiplayer AI integration.
[/list]


Thank you guys for all the patience and the suggestions/questions! I really appreciate them and im amazed how quickly this has grown and how big its now become! This has been a dream of mine for a while and Lucky to be able to have you all here to help it become reality.

Thank you,
-Phonicz

notes.title: Steam Store Page Release + Development Timeline for November
notes.notes:
Hello SCP:FF Community!

I'm [i]Phonicz[/i], the lead and solo developer of SCP : Forgotten Facility. I'm really proud to finally have the game out on steam, and want to give you guys a short update on the current state of the game, as well as future plans for this current month of November.

This has been my dream for the past 6 months, and along with my small studio (Arcmeda Studios) we have been able to develop the game this much so far and I'm really proud of it and amazed all of you also want to be along for the ride!

Also a key note I want to put out there, I'm making this game for players, and I want them to be the ones that help shape the game. So I [u]strongly[/u] encourage you guys to post on steam/discord or reddit. On the discord we have a command that gives you access to a private channel to give your suggestion to the developers and design team as well.

[b]Important info about updates and news.[/b]
[list]
[*] More frequent updates are posted on our discord, Join from the website on the store page.
[*] Monthly Reports on development progress are made in the reddit, also listed on the website.
[*] We will try to do semi-monthly or weekly reports on steam as well, whenever a large update gets added.
[/list]

[b]Onto information about the game in its current state:[/b]
Current the game has its framework, weapon mechanics, guns are mostly organized just need to put meshes and such in. The characters are started and getting their key features implemented, with the human ones being done. The maps procedural generation system works with 100% accuracy, and the menu is all setup and working with no reported bugs.

As always of course we have more info on that associated social media, but for now this is a short update to let you all know how its going. I have also attached a few images (some of which have been shown on the store page) to this announcement.

And one again, thank you for all the support!
-Phonicz
